home.title: Stack App 2025 v1
home.subtitle: REST API Server Framework based on Spring Boot 4.x
home.intro: A Full-Stack Starter Project (Spring Boot 4 + Vue 3) for individual developers to quickly build scalable backend services in on-premise or cloud environments.

logged.message: You are logged in as "{ username }".
logged.guide: You can use various management functions through the top menu, such as User Management, Entity Management, and System Monitoring.

consistency.title: API Consistency
consistency.desc: RFC 7807-based common error response structure for consistent exception handling across all clients.

security.title: Enhanced Security
security.desc: Provides Spring Security + JWT-based authentication/authorization and Role-based access control.

performance.title: Performance Optimization
performance.desc: Leverages Hibernate 2nd Cache and Redis to reduce DB load and improve response times.

scalability.title: Scalability
scalability.desc: Seamless integration with various infrastructures like Redis, Kafka, and MQTT.

docs.title: Auto Documentation
docs.desc: Automatically generate and test API documentation via Swagger (OpenAPI).

features.title: Key Features
features.db: Liquibase-based DB version control and multi-DB compatibility
features.cloud: Supports immediate deployment to Cloud (OCI, Azure) and On-premise
features.vue: Frontend based on Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript + Pinia

backend.title: Backend
backend.stack: Spring Boot 4, Java 21, JPA, Redis, Liquibase, Security
